## Type of change

- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix

## Priority

- [ ] P0 — current sprint
- [ ] P1 — near-term gap
- [ ] P2 — mid-term expansion
- [ ] P3 — long-term backlog

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes (new/changed tests included)
- [ ] Shared types updated in `@bookdock/shared` if API changed
- [ ] Architecture doc (`docs/architecture.md`) updated if design changed
- [ ] Plan doc (`docs/plan.md`) updated if scope changed
